descriptionChirho: The proper noun Ἰσραήλ referring to the nation of Israel, the people of Israel, or the patriarch Jacob/Israel. An indeclinable Semitic name appearing across all grammatical cases (nominative, accusative, genitive, dative, vocative) with consistent transliteration across languages: Spanish 'Israēl,' Hindi 'इस्राएल,' Arabic 'إسرائيل,' Korean '이스라엘,' Swahili 'Israeli.' The two clusters differ only in case inflection context (67x general vs 1x genitive-only), not in referential meaning.
